answer_1.quote: we fine-tune a large, pre-trained Transformer encoder-decoder on the dialogues in the LIGHT dataset for all generation experiments.

answer_2.quote: We measure the percent of gendered words generated in the dialogue (% gend. words) and the percent of male bias (% male bias), i.e. the percent of male-gendered words out of all generated gendered words.

answer_4.quote: We use the dialogue evaluation system Acute-Eval to ask evaluators to compare pairs of conversations from models and decide which model generates (i) more biased dialogues and (ii) more engaging dialogues.
answer_4.guideline: evaluators compare pairs of conversations and decide which model generates more biased or more engaging dialogues
